video:video.video:description: Just days after organizers announced it would be postponed due to fears of increased ICE activity, El Grito Chicago, a downtown Mexican Independence Day festival, has been rescheduled for September 15 at a neighborhood church.

video:video.video:title: FBI release photos of person of interest in Kirk shooting and offer $100k reward
video:video.video:description: The FBI have released photos of a potential suspect in the shooting of Charlie Kirk. The individual was captured by security cameras in the area wearing sunglasses, a black hat and black long-sleeve shirt.

video:video.video:title: UN votes to let Palestinian leader address General Assembly by video after US visa denial
video:video.video:description: The United Nations General Assembly on Friday voted to allow Palestinian President Mahmoud Abbas to address its annual meeting of world leaders by video after the United States revoked his visa last month.

video:video.video:title: A halted escalator and teleprompter woes — Trump’s UN visit gets a shaky start
video:video.video:description: President Trump's visit to the U.N. got off to a shaky start when an escalator stopped right after he got on it.

video:video.video:title: Jimmy Kimmel's audience reacts to show being suspended
video:video.video:description: The crowd lined up to attend "Jimmy Kimmel Live!" on Wednesday were turned away just before they expected to enter the theater in Hollywood, according to one audience member.

video:video.video:title: Human rights experts join rising chorus that accuses Israel of genocide in Gaza
video:video.video:description: A team of independent experts commissioned by the United Nations' Human Rights Council has concluded that Israel is committing genocide in Gaza, issuing a report Tuesday that calls on the international community to end the genocide and take steps to punish those responsible for it.

video:video.video:title: Deadly Tropical Storm Bualoi batters Philippines, forcing hundreds of thousands to evacuate homes
video:video.video:description: Another tropical storm barreled across Philippine islands on Friday, causing at least four deaths and the evacuations of more than 433,000 people.

video:video.video:title: Maduro says relations between Venezuela and the US are broken after strikes on boats
video:video.video:description: Venezuela’s president, Nicolás Maduro, on Monday said relations with the U.S. are broken after strikes against boats in Caribbean waters.

video:video.video:title: Nepal’s PM resigns after 19 killed in protests against social media ban and corruption
video:video.video:description: Nepal’s prime minister resigned Tuesday as protests escalated following a ban on popular social media platforms and the deaths of 19 protesters.

video:video.video:title: California bans most law enforcement officers from wearing masks during operations
video:video.video:description: California on Saturday became the first state to ban most law enforcement, including federal immigration agents, from covering their faces while conducting official business under a bill signed by Democratic Governor Gavin Newsom.

video:video.video:title: Trump announces plans to move U.S. Space Command from Colorado to Alabama
video:video.video:description: President Donald Trump announced Tuesday that U.S. Space Command will be located in Alabama, reversing a decision by former President Joe Biden to keep it in Colorado.

video:video.video:title: Residents react to rural Pennsylvania shooting that left 3 police officers dead and 2 injured
video:video.video:description: Area residents react to an incident in which three police officers were fatally shot and two wounded in southern Pennsylvania.

video:video.video:title: Vietnam evacuates thousands and shuts airports as Typhoon Bualoi makes landfall
video:video.video:description: Vietnam evacuated thousands of people from its central and northern provinces Sunday as Typhoon Bualoi raced toward the country faster than expected and made landfall in the early hours of Monday.

video:video.video:title: Troy Kotsur on deaf culture in film and TV: 'Just the beginning'
video:video.video:description: Troy Kotsur on deaf culture in film and TV: 'Just the beginning'

video:video.video:title: How to simplify your skin care routine
video:video.video:description: Everywhere you turn, someone's showing you a multistep skin care routine they swear by. Dermatologists say skin care has gotten way too complicated and that social media is filled with information that can be misleading.

video:video.video:title: ABC ends Jimmy Kimmel's suspension and his show will return Tuesday
video:video.video:description: ABC announced Monday that it will reinstate Jimmy Kimmel’s late-night show in the wake of criticism over his comments about the assassination of conservative activist Charlie Kirk.

video:video.video:title: Pro-Palestinian protesters march to the UN as Netanyahu addresses General Assembly
video:video.video:description: Hundreds of pro-Palestinian protesters gathered Friday in New York as Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu addressed the General Assembly, including Colombian President Gustavo Petro.

video:video.video:title: Super typhoon causes some damage as it blows past northern Philippines
video:video.video:description: Thousands of people were evacuated from northern Philippine villages and schools and offices were closed Monday in the archipelago and neighboring Taiwan as one of this year's strongest typhoons threatened to cause flooding and landslides on its way to southeastern China.

video:video.video:title: Kash Patel and Cory Booker get in a shouting match at Senate hearing
video:video.video:description: FBI Director Kash Patel and Sen. Cory Booker got in a shouting match during Patel’s appearance Tuesday before the Senate Judiciary Committee.

video:video.video:title: Trump draws cheers and boos while marking 9/11 by attending a New York Yankees game
video:video.video:description: President Donald Trump attended the New York Yankees game on Thursday night, drawing a mixed reaction while marking the 24th anniversary of the Sept. 11 attacks, after honoring the memories of the victims at the Pentagon earlier in the day.

video:video.video:title: Reaction from Rome and Paris to death of iconic fashion designer Giorgio Armani
video:video.video:description: Giorgio Armani, the iconic Italian designer who turned the concept of understated elegance into a multibillion-dollar fashion empire, died Thursday, his fashion house confirmed.

video:video.video:title: Jerry quits Ben & Jerry's, saying independence on social issues stifled
video:video.video:description: Ben & Jerry’s co-founder Jerry Greenfield is leaving the ice cream brand after 47 years, saying that the independence it once had to speak up on social issues has been stifled by its parent company Unilever.

video:video.video:title: Relatives mourn after Israeli strikes in Gaza City kill at least 34 Palestinians
video:video.video:description: Israeli strikes in Gaza City overnight and into Tuesday killed at least 34 Palestinians, according to the Shifa Hospital, which received the bodies.

video:video.video:title: Laila Lockhart Kraner compares working with Kristen Wiig to 'comedy masterclass'
video:video.video:description: Kraner stars alongside Kristen Wiig and Gloria Estefan in 'Gabby's Dollhouse: The Movie.' The live-action hybrid film is in theaters now. (September 26)

video:video.video:description: Thousands of Hezbollah supporters gathered at a scenic overlook on Beirut's coast Thursday and projected images of the group's former longtime leader, Hassan Nasrallah, and his successor, Hashem Safieddine, on the iconic arched Raouche rock to commemorate their deaths in Israeli airstrikes nearly a

video:video.video:title: Charlie Kirk backers leave flowers at Turning Point headquarters
video:video.video:description: Supporters of Charlie Kirk showed up outside Turning Point USA's headquarters after his death.

video:video.video:title: Kansas City residents speak out against redistricting efforts
video:video.video:description: Some Missouri residents are denouncing a plan to redraw the state's congressional districts at the urging of President Donald Trump.

video:video.video:title: Casa Kahlo Museum opens in Mexico City, revealing intimate details of Frida Kahlo's life
video:video.video:description: The secrets of the Kahlo family are being revealed with the opening of the Casa Kahlo Museum in Mexico City.

video:video.video:title: Helicopters bring aid after devastating earthquake hits eastern Afghanistan
video:video.video:description: Helicopters brought aid to Afghanistan's Kunar province on Monday after a strong earthquake devastated the area, killing 800 and injuring thousands more.

video:video.video:title: US Treasury Secretary Bessent says framework deal on TikTok reached with China
video:video.video:description: A framework deal has been reached for the ownership of popular social video platform TikTok, U.S. Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent said after weekend trade talks between the U.S. and China in Spain.

video:video.video:title: Chicago immigration attorney says Trump threats have sparked fear in the city's immigrant community
video:video.video:description: As President Donald Trump ramps up threats of a sweeping immigration crackdown in Chicago, an immigration attorney is seeing people become more afraid to move through their everyday lives.

video:video.video:title: Portuguese officials day of mourning after Lisbon streetcar crash
video:video.video:description: A famous streetcar popular with tourists in Lisbon crashed on Wednesday, killing 17 people. Portugal observed a national day of mourning Thursday after the capital’s worst disaster in recent history.

video:video.video:title: People march in Chicago against President Trump's threats to send federal agents into the city
video:video.video:description: People participated in a protest in Chicago ahead of federal authorities kicking off a major immigration enforcement action on President Donald Trump's orders.

video:video.video:title: Massive mudslide sweeps through mountainous California neighborhood
video:video.video:description: Flooding and mudslides carrying trees and rocks buried roads, damaged homes and trapped drivers in several southern California communities, authorities said.

video:video.video:title: How Windsor prepares to welcome Trump for second state visit
video:video.video:description: U.S. President Donald Trump will arrive in the UK on Tuesday for a state visit during which the British government hopes a technology deal will show the trans-Atlantic bond remains strong despite differences over Ukraine, the Middle East and the future of the Western alliance.

video:video.video:title: LA County wildfire response slowed by lack of resources, outdated alert process, report says
video:video.video:description: A lack of resources and outdated policies for sending emergency alerts led to delayed evacuation warnings as flames began consuming neighborhoods during deadly Los Angeles-area wildfires in January, according to an outside review produced by the consulting firm McChrystal Group.

video:video.video:title: Norway votes in a closely fought election with the future of a wealth tax in focus
video:video.video:description: Norwegians headed to the polls Monday in the main day of voting for a new parliament, after a campaign in which the future of a wealth tax that dates to the late 19th century has been a central issue.

video:video.video:title: Indian-controlled Kashmir struggles to recover after relentless monsoon rains unleash deadly floods
video:video.video:description: Floodwaters entered many residential areas on the outskirts of Srinagar, the main city in Indian-controlled Kashmir, on Thursday after a breach of the Jhelum river embankment.

video:video.video:title: Grieving relatives receive remains of loved ones killed in days of violent protests in Nepal
video:video.video:description: Dozens of people were killed in the violent protests on Monday and Tuesday which saw the collapse of the previous government.

video:video.video:title: North Carolina governor calls for red flag law
video:video.video:description: North Carolina Governor Josh Stein says the state needs a red flag law to allow guns to be taken away from people who pose a threat to the public.

video:video.video:title: Man who represented himself is found guilty of trying to assassinate Trump at Florida golf course, AP Explains
video:video.video:description: The man charged with trying to assassinate Donald Trump at a Florida golf course last year tried to stab himself in the neck with a pen shortly after being found guilty of all counts on Tuesday.

video:video.video:title: Authorities say student who had been radicalized fired revolver at Colorado school, wounding 2
video:video.video:description: Authorities say student who had been radicalized fired revolver at Colorado school, wounding 2

video:video.video:title: Marjorie Taylor Greene joins Epstein survivors calling to release the files
video:video.video:description: Survivors of Jeffrey Epstein's sexual abuse made their voices heard Tuesday on Capitol Hill, pressuring lawmakers to force the release of the sex trafficking investigation into the late financier and pushing back President Donald Trump's effort to dismiss the issue as a “hoax.”

video:video.video:title: 160-mile march for democracy arrives in Washington from Philadelphia
video:video.video:description: Over the span of 14 days, nearly 200 people marched from Philadelphia to Washington, DC in defense of democracy. (AP Video: Mike Pesoli)

video:video.video:title: Chicago area resident is concerned about the potential impact of ICE operations on her family and business
video:video.video:description: Just one street over from the immigration processing facility expected to be key to President Trump's Chicago area ICE operations, a local resident grapples with the implications for her children and her family's business.

video:video.video:title: Once again, an endangered orca in Washington state is seen carrying a dead calf
video:video.video:description: Researchers with the Center for Whale Research, Sea Doc Society and San Diego Zoo Wildlife Alliance said they received reports on Friday that the whale — identified as J36 — was pushing the dead calf in Rosario Strait, part of the Salish Sea in the San Juan Islands.

video:video.video:title: Conservative activist Charlie Kirk shot at Utah college event
video:video.video:description: Charlie Kirk, the CEO and co-founder of the conservative youth organization Turning Point USA, was shot Wednesday at an event at a Utah college, Turning Point said.

video:video.video:title: Trump hosts Poland's new president at the White House, vows continued robust US troop presence
video:video.video:description: President Donald Trump welcomed Poland’s new president, Karol Nawrocki, to the White House on Wednesday, vowing to maintain a strong U.S. military presence in his country and adding, “we’ll put more there if they want.”

video:video.video:title: German investigated in McCann disappearance released after serving sentence in an unrelated case
video:video.video:description: A German man who is under investigation in the disappearance of British toddler Madeleine McCann 18 years ago was released from prison Wednesday after serving his sentence in an unrelated case, police said.

video:video.video:title: UK, Canada and Australia formally recognize a Palestinian state; AP explains
video:video.video:description: The coordinated initiative from the three Commonwealth nations and longtime allies reflects growing outrage at Israel’s conduct of the war in Gaza and the continued expansion of settlements in the West Bank.

video:video.video:title: New findings by NASA Mars rover provide strongest hints yet of potential signs of ancient life
video:video.video:description: NASA's Mars rover Perseverance has uncovered rocks in a dry river channel that may hold potential signs of ancient microscopic life.

video:video.video:title: 'Hero rats' in Tanzania detect land mines and tuberculosis
video:video.video:description: They're known as 'hero rats' and for good reason. In Tanzania, African giant pouched rats are being trained to sniff out landmines, diseases and even humans buried under rubble

video:video.video:title: Trump tells Australian reporter: 'You're hurting Australia'
video:video.video:description: President Donald Trump, on Tuesday, told an Australian journalist ’you’re hurting Australia.' The journalist had asked the president about his wealth since returning to office.

video:video.video:title: Illinois governor urges people to not give Trump reason to send National Guard
video:video.video:description: Chicago residents are bracing for an influx of immigration agents. Community leaders have been busy planning protests and advising residents about their rights.

video:video.video:title: Saving the finless porpoise of China’s longest river
video:video.video:description: Scientists in China are ramping up conservation efforts for the rare creatures of the Yangtze - the country's longest river.
